title: onopordum carmanicum
intro: Onopordum carmanicum, commonly known as the Cretan thistle, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and studies have revealed its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Onopordum carmanicum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
